**Chinese name:** 晶晨半导体（上海）股份有限公司 (Jīngchén Bàndǎotǐ)

::: {.callout-tip}
## Why This Matters
China's most globally embedded video SoC designer — its chips run operator boxes worldwide (Netflix/Google-certified) and, from Q4 2026, Samsung TVs enter volume on its silicon. FY2025: ¥67.93亿 revenue (+14.6%), record 174M chips; H1 2026 ¥43.91亿 (+31.9%) with TV SoC shipments +30%; guided FY2026 +25-45%.
:::

## What does this firm design?

4K/8K STB and smart-TV SoCs, edge-AI NPU platforms, vision-AI and Wi-Fi 6 connectivity chips.

## Key Facts

| | |
|---|---|
| **Category** | Fabless |
| **Founded** | 2003 |
| **Location** | Shanghai, Shanghai Municipality |
| **Product Focus** | Smart set-top-box/TV SoCs (S/T lines), AIoT, smart-vision (C line), Wi-Fi 6 (W line); ~270 global operator customers |
| **Node Sophistication** | 6nm in mass production — first ARMv9-based 6nm STB SoC (~9M units 2025, 30M targeted 2026); the most advanced consumer-SoC node among the listed design houses |
| **Entity List** | No |
